lines.t:
The standby state of a <c:ffff00>Crossfire<c> <c:ffff00>attack<c> for
performing a <c:ffff00>combo attack<c> with allies.
In the CF Stance, no other <c:ffff00>act<c> can be performed and
the Medabot becomes <c:ffff00>unable to evade<c>. When an {{ally_battle_term}}
finishes {{prep}} on their <c:ffff00>trigger<c> attack, the combo
attack is carried out.
It also ends if allies act 3 times or a set time
passes: a normal attack is made and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c>
begins.
